title: Phishing Response Playbook
content:
1. Block sending domain at email gateway.
2. Search mail logs for all recipients.
3. Force password resets for users who clicked.
4. Check auth logs for logins from suspicious IPs within 30 minutes of click events.
5. Send all-staff awareness alert within 2 hours.
6. Report domain to KE-CIRT and PhishTank.

KALRO note: Users are more likely to fall for emails spoofing IT support during maintenance windows.

title: Ransomware Containment and Recovery
content:
1. Isolate infected machine immediately — pull network cable.
2. Do NOT shut down — volatile memory may contain decryption keys.
3. Identify variant using ID Ransomware (upload ransom note).
4. Check NoMoreRansom.org for known decryptor before considering payment.
5. Check shared drives for encrypted files.
6. Restore from most recent clean backup — verify integrity first.
7. Reimage before reconnecting.

KALRO: Research backups on NAS at backup-nas-01. Snapshots every 6 hours. Contact David Kamau for access.

title: DDoS Mitigation — Upstream Filtering
content:
Safaricom Business provides upstream DDoS filtering under enterprise SLA.
1. Call Safaricom NOC 24/7 — get current number from ICT manager.
2. Provide account number, describe attack type and volume.
3. Request null-routing or scrubbing center activation.
4. Activation time: 15-30 minutes.
5. Monitor border router during mitigation.

Alternative: Enable Cloudflare Under Attack Mode if domain is proxied.

title: Compromised DB Credentials — Investigation
content:
1. Lock the compromised account immediately.
2. Pull 30 days of auth logs.
3. Check for data exfiltration — review SELECT queries on sensitive tables.
4. Check credential reuse across systems.
5. Interview account owner.
6. Preserve logs before remediation.
7. Escalate to HR and legal before confronting the user if insider threat suspected.

KALRO: Audit logs at /var/log/mysql/audit.log on hr-db-server-01. 90-day retention.

title: PowerShell Obfuscation Detection
content:
Indicators: Base64-encoded args, Invoke-Expression (IEX), download cradles.

1. Collect PowerShell transcript from machine.
2. Decode base64: [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String("..."))
3. Submit to VirusTotal.
4. Block C2 IP at firewall immediately.
5. Check for new scheduled tasks and registry run keys.

Preventive: Enable Constrained Language Mode on non-admin workstations via Group Policy.

title: Phishing-Induced KALRO Account Compromise Response
content:
Use this playbook when a KALRO user reports phishing and there is evidence of unauthorized account access.

Containment actions:
1. Revoke all active sessions and refresh tokens for the affected @kalro.org account.
2. Temporarily disable or lock the affected account if unauthorized access is confirmed.
3. Remove unauthorized mailbox forwarding rules, delegates, or persistence settings.
4. Block the phishing sender, URL, and related indicators at the email/web security controls.
5. Preserve authentication and mailbox audit logs before making further changes.

Recovery actions:
6. Reset the user password using a verified administrator workflow.
7. Verify or re-register MFA and confirm recovery information has not been changed.
8. Review sign-in, mailbox, and access logs for suspicious activity or data access.
9. Restore account access only after unauthorized sessions and persistence are removed.
10. Monitor the account for recurring suspicious activity and search for other recipients of the same phishing message.

Escalate when the affected account is privileged, multiple users are compromised, sensitive data may have been accessed, lateral movement is suspected, or the above actions do not stop suspicious activity.

containment_actions: Revoke all active sessions and refresh tokens for the affected account
Temporarily disable or lock the affected account
Remove unauthorized mailbox forwarding rules, delegates, or persistence settings
Block the phishing sender, URL, and related indicators
Preserve authentication and mailbox audit logs before further changes
Search for other recipients of the same phishing message and identify additional affected users
Review recent privilege, MFA, recovery-information, and password-reset changes
Assess whether sensitive mailbox or connected-service data was accessed or exported
recovery_actions: Reset the user password using a verified administrator workflow
Verify or re-register MFA and confirm recovery information has not been changed
Confirm unauthorized forwarding rules, delegates, sessions, and persistence are removed
Review sign-in, mailbox, and access logs for suspicious activity or data access
Restore account access only after validation checks pass
Notify the affected user of the recovery actions and required precautions
Monitor the account for recurring suspicious activity for the defined observation period
Confirm no other users remain affected by the same phishing campaign
success_criteria: Unauthorized forwarding rules, delegates, and persistence are removed
Credentials, MFA, and recovery information are secured
No further suspicious sign-ins occur during validation
Potential data access has been reviewed and documented
Other recipients of the same phishing campaign have been assessed
escalation_conditions: Sensitive data access or exfiltration is suspected
Knowledge-guided containment is partial or unsuccessful
verification_checks: Unauthorized forwarding rules, delegates, and persistence are removed
Credentials, MFA, and recovery information are secured
No further suspicious sign-ins occur during validation
Potential data access has been reviewed and documented
Other recipients of the same phishing campaign have been assessed
